privileges.name: Read Operations Status
privileges.description: See cluster, drill, incident and upgrade status.

privileges.name: Switch Database Leader
privileges.description: Move the database leader to another node (a planned switchover).

privileges.name: Run Recovery Drills
privileges.description: Start a backup-restore or failover drill.

privileges.name: Manage Recovery Drills
privileges.description: Schedule recovery drills and change their settings.

privileges.name: Read Drill Evidence
privileges.description: Read signed recovery-drill reports and their evidence, for an auditor.

privileges.name: Declare a Disaster
privileges.description: Declare a disaster and start the recovery runbook.

privileges.name: Publish Incidents
privileges.description: Publish and update incident notices on the status page.

privileges.name: Run Upgrades
privileges.description: Start and roll back platform upgrades.

roles.name: Operations
roles.description: Runs the deployment's reliability work: cluster switchover, recovery drills, disaster declaration, incident notices, upgrades and fault injection.

roles.name: Auditor
roles.description: Reads operations status and the signed evidence of recovery drills; changes nothing.
